tickets.title: Evaluate and coordinate retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client is considering moving assets from an employer retirement plan to an IRA or another qualified plan. Confirm the reason for the rollover, compare available options, document key plan features, review investment and tax considerations, and coordinate transfer instructions only after the client has selected a rollover path. Arden Cloverwhisk's Paper Otter Robotics 401(k) shows about $612,000 across pretax, Roth, and employer match sources after his January 2026 separation; the current plan statement, source breakdown, vesting details, loan status, and summary plan information are needed before comparing choices for the former employer plan.

subTasks.title: Collect current plan details and client objectives
subTasks.text: Request the latest plan statement, summary plan description if available, vesting details, outstanding loan status, after-tax or Roth source balances, and the client's rollover goals. Note whether the client is separated from service, retiring, changing employers, or consolidating accounts. Arden Cloverwhisk separated from Paper Otter Robotics in January 2026 after a division sale.

subTasks.title: Compare rollover options and tax considerations
subTasks.text: Evaluate keeping assets in the current plan, rolling to a new employer plan, rolling to an IRA, or taking any permitted distribution. Flag potential tax withholding, Roth treatment, net unrealized appreciation, creditor protection, fees, investment access, and required minimum distribution implications.

subTasks.title: Prepare implementation instructions
subTasks.text: After the advisor documents the recommendation and client direction, prepare custodian or plan paperwork, verify registration details, confirm direct rollover payee instructions, and outline the expected transfer sequence.

subTasks.title: Confirm receipt and invest according to plan
subTasks.text: Track rollover receipt, confirm cost basis or source breakdown if applicable, reconcile the amount received against the final plan statement, and notify the portfolio team when assets are ready for investment.

tickets.title: Review account access recovery request
tickets.text:
Review the access recovery request before any reset, credential change, profile update, or custodian escalation is completed.

Criteria to verify:
- The requester is authorized for the account or relationship.
- Identity verification has been completed using approved firm procedures.
- The access issue is clearly described, including whether it relates to username, password, multifactor authentication, locked profile, email change, phone change, or online enrollment.
- No suspicious change request is paired with the recovery attempt, such as a new external bank, address change, email change, or urgent distribution request.
- The custodian or platform process has been followed without bypassing required controls.

Evidence to collect:
- Date and method of client contact.
- Staff member who completed identity verification.
- Summary of the issue and requested access action.
- Screenshots or platform case number if permitted by policy.
- Custodian confirmation or ticket reference.
- Notes showing whether any related money movement or profile-change hold is required. Arden Cloverwhisk reported the Velvet Acorn Custody connection failed twice during portal setup after multifactor authentication, leaving the taxable brokerage account (about $438,000) unavailable for the initial portfolio review.
tickets.evidence: Arden reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody connection failed twice during portal setup after multifactor authentication, leaving the taxable brokerage account unavailable for the initial portfolio review; the agreed follow-up is to address external account aggregation access by 2026-02-17.
